agent_explanation: Energy is stable (~493 J) until step 4 wall collision, when a grazing impact on the thin horizontal wall (w=3.4,h=0.3 at 8.9,2.8) with high restitution e=0.937 increases speed from 30.8 to 33.29 and raises total energy to 573.49 J (+80 J) despite e<1 and no controller work. Distance to wall goes 0.155->0.11 while velocity flips from (11.2,28.7) to (-24.9,-22.0). The impulse/positional-correction at the wall edge spuriously adds kinetic energy (corner/edge normal handling or substep splitting error), violating conservation. Lowering e to 0 removes the gain.
